title: Mascara 101 Lengthening and Lifting
descriptionHtml:
✓ Clean + Planet Aware✓ Fragrance Free✓ Lengthening✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Without Parabens✓ Volumizing

What it is: Lifting and lengthening mascara for full, feathered lashes in a flash.

Formulation Type: Lengthening


Highlighted Ingredients:
-Beeswax: Allows the mascara to coat, lengthen, and stiffen (but not harden) lashes.

- Shea Butter: Moisturizing and nourishing, it also creates a silky, smooth texture.

- Hydra-Mineral Complex: Rich in minerals for lash strengthening.


Ingredient Callouts: This product is cruelty-free.


What Else You Need to Know: This formula uses nourishing shea butter, beeswax and our hydra-mineral complex to lift and separate every lash.

How to Use+

Suggested Usage:
-Place the wand on the base of upper lashes then stroke upward.

-Use small bristles at the tip for small lashes on the outer corners and bottom lash line.

-Use one coat for a natural, lengthened look.

-Try two to three coats for extra thickening and impact.


Recycling Instructions:

-Make sure your mascara tube is empty!

-Trim off the spoolie and throw in the trash– this piece is not yet recyclable.

-Recycle the cap, vial, and rod via your home recycling bin. Because Mascara 101's components are small, we can't guarantee they will make it to the recycling stream. We've partnered with Pact Collective to make sure your hard-to-recycle items get recycled. Head to this link to get started: bit.ly/3QKdhuj

--All of our secondary cartons are made from 100% post-consumer waste and FSC-certified paper. Simply toss them in your home recycling bin and you’re good to go.

Ingredients+
-Beeswax: Allows the mascara to coat, lengthen, and stiffen (but not harden) lashes.
-Shea Butter: Moisturizing and nourishing, it also creates a silky, smooth texture.
-Hydra-Mineral Complex: Rich in minerals for strengthening.

Water/Aqua/Eau, Beeswax/Cera Alba/Cire D'abeille, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Polyglyceryl-6 Distearate, Dimer Dilinoleyl Dimer Dilinoleate, Glycerin, Copernicia Cerifera (Carnauba) Wax / Cera Carnauba/Cire De Carnauba, Polyglyceryl-10 Myristate, Cetyl Alcohol, Glyceryl Caprylate, Leuconostoc/Radish Root Ferment Filtrate, Zea Mays (Corn) Starch, Xanthan Gum, Arginine, Phenethyl Alcohol, Agropyron Repens Root Extract, Potassium Sorbate, Sodium Benzoate, Iron Oxides (Ci 77499).



The list of ingredients is subject to change, please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
